# ClipCast — Landing Page Build Instructions

## Overview

ClipCast is an async video messaging and screen recording platform targeting professionals, remote teams, and enterprises. Think Loom-style product positioning: the site needs to feel **modern, professional, yet playful** — approachable enough for individual signups but polished enough to close enterprise deals. The brand promise is "One video is worth a thousand words."

## Visual Direction

Use a **clean, airy layout** with generous whitespace. Primary palette should lean into vibrant purple/indigo accents against white backgrounds, with subtle gradients for depth. Typography should be a modern geometric sans-serif (Inter, Plus Jakarta Sans, or similar) — large bold headlines, comfortable body text. Rounded corners, soft shadows, and smooth transitions throughout. Illustrations and UI mockups should feel lightweight and contemporary. Buttons should be bold and high-contrast with clear hover states.

## Key Priorities

**Pricing page accuracy is critical.** The billing toggle (monthly/annual with "save up to 17%" badge), team size slider, expandable comparison table, and FAQ accordion must all function correctly with accurate data. This page carries the heaviest interactive load — get it right.

**Navigation flow matters.** Five pages are interconnected with specific link triggers. Ensure the shared nav bar consistently links Home → Enterprise, Pricing, Login, and Signup across all main pages. CTA buttons ("Get Started for free", "Try for free") must route to signup.

**The home page is dense** — 15 sections including a features grid, use cases, integrations, security, testimonials, and blog teasers. Prioritize visual hierarchy so it doesn't feel overwhelming. Use alternating background tones and clear section breaks.

**Login and signup pages** should be minimal and focused — social auth buttons (Google, Slack, Apple, Outlook, SSO) plus email input. The signup page pairs the form with a testimonial sidebar for social proof.

**Cookie consent banner** on the home page needs accept/reject plus a manage-preferences modal with category toggles.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

React framework with SSR, SSG, RSC, and optimization features **Turborepo** - High-performance monorepo build system for JavaScript/TypeScript **RemixIcon** - Icon library with 3,100+ outlined and filled style icons ## When to Use This Skill Group - Building new full-stack web applications with modern React - Setting up monorepos with multiple apps and shared packages - Implementing server-side rendering and static generation - Optimizing build performance with intelligent caching - Creating consistent UI with professional iconography - Managing workspace dependencies across multiple projects - Deploying production-ready applications with proper optimization ## Stack Selection Guide ### Single Application: Next.js + RemixIcon Use when building a standalone application: - E-commerce sites - Marketing websites - SaaS applications - Documentation sites - Blogs and content platforms **Setup:** ```bash npx create-next-app@latest my-app cd my-app npm install remixicon ``` ### Monorepo: Next.js + Turborepo + RemixIcon Use when building multiple applications with shared code: - Microfrontends - Multi-tenant platforms - Internal tools with shared component library - Multiple apps (web, admin, mobile-web) sharing logic - Design system with documentation site **Setup:** ```bash npx create-turbo@latest my-monorepo # Then configure Next.js apps in apps/ directory # Install remixicon in shared UI packages ``` ### Framework Features Comparison | Feature | Next.js | Turborepo | RemixIcon | |---------|---------|-----------|-----------| | Primary Use | Web framework | Build system | UI icons | | Best For | SSR/SSG apps | Monorepos | Consistent iconography | | Performance | Built-in optimization | Caching & parallel tasks | Lightweight fonts/SVG | | TypeScript | Full support | Full support | Type definitions available | ## Quick Start ### Next.js Application ```bash # Create new project npx create-next-app@latest my-app cd my-app # Install RemixIcon npm install remixicon # Import in layout # app/layout.tsx import 'remixicon/fonts/remixicon.css' # Start development npm run dev ``` ### Turborepo Monorepo ```bash # Create monorepo npx create-turbo@latest my-monorepo cd my-monorepo # Structure: # apps/web/ - Next.js application # apps/docs/ - Documentation site # packages/ui/ - Shared components with RemixIcon # packages/config/ - Shared configs # turbo.json - Pipeline configuration # Run all apps npm run dev # Build all packages npm run build ``` ### RemixIcon Integration ```tsx // Webfont (HTML/CSS) // React component import { RiHomeLine, RiSearchFill } from "@remixicon/react" ``` ## Reference Navigation **Next.js References:** - [App Router Architecture](./references/nextjs-app-router.md) - Routing, layouts, pages, parallel routes - [Server Components](./references/nextjs-server-components.md) - RSC patterns, client vs server, streaming - [Data Fetching](./references/nextjs-data-fetching.md) - fetch API, caching, revalidation, loading states - [Optimization](./references/nextjs-optimization.md) - Images, fonts, scripts, bundle analysis, PPR **Turborepo References:** - [Setup & Configuration](./references/turborepo-setup.md) - Installation, workspace config, package structure - [Task Pipelines](./references/turborepo-pipelines.md) - Dependencies, parallel execution, task ordering - [Caching Strategies](./references/turborepo-caching.md) - Local cache, remote cache, cache invalidation **RemixIcon References:** - [Integration Guide](./references/remix-icon-integration.md) - Installation, usage, customization, accessibility ## Common Patterns & Workflows ### Pattern 1: Full-Stack Monorepo ``` my-monorepo/ ├── apps/ │ ├── web/ # Customer-facing Next.js app │ ├── admin/ # Admin dashboard Next.js app │ └── docs/ # Documentation site ├── packages/ │ ├── ui/ # Shared UI with RemixIcon │ ├── api-client/ # API client library │ ├── config/ # ESLint, TypeScript configs │ └── types/ # Shared TypeScript types └── turbo.json # Build pipeline ``` **turbo.json:** ```json { "$schema": "https://turbo.build/schema.json", "pipeline": { "build": { "dependsOn": ["^build"], "outputs": [".next/**", "!.next/cache/**", "dist/**"] }, "dev": { "cache": false, "persistent": true }, "lint": {}, "test": { "dependsOn": ["build"] } } } ``` ### Pattern 2: Shared Component Library ```tsx // packages/ui/src/button.tsx import { RiLoader4Line } from "@remixicon/react" export function Button({ children, loading, icon }) { return ( ) } // apps/web/app/page.tsx import { Button } from "@repo/ui/button" import { RiHomeLine } from "@remixicon/react" export default function Page() { return } ``` ### Pattern 3: Optimized Data Fetching ```tsx // app/posts/[slug]/page.tsx import { notFound } from 'next/navigation' // Static generation at build time export async function generateStaticParams() { const posts = await getPosts() return posts.map(post => ({ slug: post.slug })) } // Revalidate every hour async function getPost(slug: string) { const res = await fetch(`https://api.example.com/posts/${slug}`, { next: { revalidate: 3600 } }) if (!res.ok) return null return res.json() } export default async function Post({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) { const post = await getPost(params.slug) if (!post) notFound() return
{post.content}
} ``` ### Pattern 4: Monorepo CI/CD Pipeline ```yaml # .github/workflows/ci.yml name: CI on: [push, pull_request] jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: 18 - run: npm install - run: npx turbo run build test lint env: TURBO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TOKEN }} TURBO_TEAM: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TEAM }} ``` ## Utility Scripts Python utilities in `scripts/` directory: **nextjs-init.py** - Initialize Next.js project with best practices **turborepo-migrate.py** - Convert existing monorepo to Turborepo Usage examples: ```bash # Initialize new Next.js app with TypeScript and recommended setup python scripts/nextjs-init.py --name my-app --typescript --app-router # Migrate existing monorepo to Turborepo with dry-run python scripts/turborepo-migrate.py --path ./my-monorepo --dry-run # Run tests cd scripts/tests pytest ``` ## Best Practices **Next.js:** - Default to Server Components, use Client Components only when needed - Implement proper loading and error states - Use Image component for automatic optimization - Set proper metadata for SEO - Leverage caching strategies (force-cache, revalidate, no-store) **Turborepo:** - Structure monorepo with clear separation (apps/, packages/) - Define task dependencies correctly (^build for topological) - Configure outputs for proper caching - Enable remote caching for team collaboration - Use filters to run tasks on changed packages only **RemixIcon:** - Use line style for minimal interfaces, fill for emphasis - Maintain 24x24 grid alignment for crisp rendering - Provide aria-labels for accessibility - Use currentColor for flexible theming - Prefer webfonts for multiple icons, SVG for single icons ## Resources - Next.js: https://nextjs.org/docs/llms.txt - Turborepo: https://turbo.build/repo/docs - RemixIcon: https://remixicon.com ## Implementation Checklist Building with this stack: - {
  "application": "web-design",
  "case_id": "case-tech-saas-landing-clipcast",
  "language": "en",
  "site": {
    "type": "landing-page",
    "page_count": 5,
    "audience": "professionals, remote teams, and enterprises seeking async video communication tools",
    "tone": "modern, professional, playful",
    "responsive": true,
    "dark_mode": false
  },
  "brief": {
    "title": "ClipCast — One video is worth a thousand words",
    "one_liner": "A free screen recorder and async video messaging platform that helps teams communicate faster with AI-powered video creation, editing, and sharing.",
    "goal": "Convert visitors into free users and enterprise customers by showcasing the product's screen recording, AI-powered editing, and collaboration features across use cases like sales, engineering, design, and support."
  },
  "pages": [
    {
      "page_id": "home",
      "file": "index.html",
      "sections": [
        "hero",
        "logo-bar",
        "feature-highlight",
        "screen-recorder",
        "video-editor",
        "integrations",
        "engagement",
        "security",
        "use-cases",
        "features-grid",
        "blog",
        "enterprise-cta",
        "testimonials",
        "cta-banner",
        "footer"
      ],
      "objective": "Introduce the product, highlight key features (screen recording, AI bug reports, editing, sharing, security), show social proof, and drive signups."
    },
    {
      "page_id": "enterprise",
      "file": "enterprise.html",
      "sections": [
        "hero",
        "logo-bar",
        "async-video-benefits",
        "community-visibility",
        "testimonial-quote",
        "security",
        "use-cases-grid",
        "stats",
        "integrations",
        "pricing-plans",
        "testimonials-carousel",
        "cta-banner",
        "footer"
      ],
      "objective": "Sell the enterprise plan by emphasizing async video benefits, security, scalability, integrations, and social proof from large organizations."
    },
    {
      "page_id": "pricing",
      "file": "pricing.html",
      "sections": [
        "hero",
        "plan-cards",
        "ai-features",
        "comparison-table",
        "faq",
        "logo-bar",
        "cta-banner",
        "footer"
      ],
      "objective": "Present pricing tiers (Starter, Business, Business + AI, Enterprise) with detailed feature comparison and FAQs to help users choose the right plan."
    },
    {
      "page_id": "login",
      "file": "login.html",
      "sections": [
        "header",
        "login-form"
      ],
      "objective": "Allow existing users to log in via social providers (Google, Slack, Apple, Outlook, SSO) or email."
    },
    {
      "page_id": "signup",
      "file": "signup.html",
      "sections": [
        "signup-form",
        "testimonial-sidebar"
      ],
      "objective": "Enable new users to create an account via Google or email with a testimonial for social proof."
    }
  ],
  "navigation": [
    {
      "from": "home",
      "trigger": "Enterprise nav link",
      "to": "enterprise"
    },
    {
      "from": "home",

      "to": "pricing"
    },

      "to": "login"
    },
    {
      "from": "home",

      "to": "signup"
    },
    {
      "from": "enterprise",
      "trigger": "Pricing nav link",
      "to": "pricing"
    },

      "from": "enterprise",

      "to": "login"
    },

      "to": "enterprise"

      "to": "signup"
    },
    {
      "from": "login",
      "trigger": "Sign up for free link",
      "to": "signup"
    }
  ],
  "interactions": [
    {
      "id": "pricing-billing-toggle",
      "page": "pricing",
      "trigger": "Click Monthly/Annually toggle on pricing page",
      "expected": "Plan prices update to reflect monthly or annual billing, with a save up to 17% badge on annual",
      "type": "toggle"
    },
    {
      "id": "pricing-team-size-slider",
      "page": "pricing",
      "trigger": "Adjust team size slider on pricing page",
      "expected": "Pricing or plan recommendations update based on selected team size",
      "type": "input"
    },
    {
      "id": "faq-accordion",
      "page": "pricing",
      "trigger": "Click on an FAQ question",
      "expected": "The answer expands below the question; clicking again collapses it",
      "type": "toggle"
    },
    {
      "id": "comparison-table-expand",
      "page": "pricing",
      "trigger": "Click See all features on a plan card",
      "expected": "Full feature list expands for that plan tier",
      "type": "toggle"
    },
    {
      "id": "cookie-consent-banner",
      "page": "home",
      "trigger": "Click Accept all cookies or Reject all cookies button",
      "expected": "Cookie consent banner dismisses and preferences are saved",
      "type": "state-change"
    },
    {
      "id": "cookie-manage-preferences",
      "page": "home",
      "trigger": "Click Manage preferences on cookie banner",
      "expected": "Modal opens with cookie category toggles (Targeting, Functional, Performance)",
      "type": "toggle"
    },
    {
      "id": "login-email-input",
      "page": "login",
      "trigger": "Enter work email and click Continue",
      "expected": "Proceeds to email-based authentication flow",
      "type": "input"
    },
    {
      "id": "signup-email-input",
      "page": "signup",
      "trigger": "Enter work email and click Continue",
      "expected": "Proceeds to account creation flow",
      "type": "input"
    }
  ],
  "data_display": [
    {
      "id": "pricing-comparison-table",
      "page": "pricing",
      "type": "table",
      "source_ref": "## Pricing Comparison Table",
      "expected_content": [
        "$0",
        "$18 per user / month",
        "$24 per user / month",
        "Up to 25 videos/person",
        "Unlimited",
        "5 min per video"
      ],
      "description": "A detailed feature comparison table across Starter, Business, Business + AI, and Enterprise plans showing workspace limits, recording features, editing, branding, security, and integrations."
    },
    {
      "id": "enterprise-stats",
      "page": "enterprise",
      "type": "stats",
      "source_ref": "## Enterprise Impact Stats",
      "expected_content": [
        "50% fewer meetings",
        "18% increase in traffic",
        "19% boost in reply rates"
      ],
      "description": "Key statistics showing the impact of async video on meetings, web traffic, and sales outreach reply rates."
    },
    {
      "id": "home-use-cases",
      "page": "home",
      "type": "list",
      "source_ref": "## Use Cases",
      "expected_content": [
        "Sales",
        "Engineering",
        "Customer support",
        "Design"
      ],
      "description": "List of use cases for video messaging across different team functions."
    },
    {
      "id": "home-features-grid",
      "page": "home",
      "type": "list",
      "source_ref": "## Features Grid",
      "expected_content": [
        "Screen and camera recording",
        "Easy sharing and embedding",
        "Trim and stitch video clips",
        "Transcriptions and closed captions",
        "Video privacy controls",
        "Custom background"
      ],
      "description": "Grid of powerful features for easy, custom recordings."
    },
    {
      "id": "pricing-plan-cards",
      "page": "pricing",
      "type": "list",
      "source_ref": "## Pricing Plans",
      "expected_content": [
        "Starter",
        "Business",
        "Business + AI",
        "Enterprise",
        "$0",
        "$18",
        "$24"
      ],
      "description": "Four pricing plan cards with plan names, prices, and key features listed."
    },
    {
      "id": "enterprise-security-features",
      "page": "enterprise",
      "type": "list",
      "source_ref": "## Enterprise Security",
      "expected_content": [
        "GDPR, CCPA, and SOC 2 Type 2 compliant",
        "AWS-backbone",
        "Advanced admin controls",
        "Encrypted data"
      ],
      "description": "List of enterprise-grade security and compliance features."
    }
  ]
}

1	# ClipCast — One video is worth a thousand words
2	
3	## Brand
4	ClipCast is a free screen recorder and async video messaging platform that helps teams communicate faster with AI-powered video creation, editing, and sharing. Built for professionals, remote teams, and enterprises seeking modern async communication tools.
5	
6	Brand colors: #1868DB (primary blue), #FF613D (accent orange), #292A2E (dark text)
7	
8	## Hero Content
9	Title: One video is worth a thousand words
10	Subtitle: Easily record and share AI-powered video messages with your teammates and customers to supercharge productivity
11	CTA: "Get ClipCast for free" | "Install Chrome Extension"
12	
13	## Social Proof
14	Millions of people across 400,000 companies choose ClipCast
15	Trusted by: Stripe · Dropbox · HubSpot · Atlassian · Launchdarkly · Netflix
16	
17	## Feature: AI Bug Reports
18	Label: New!
19	Title: Ship faster with AI bug reports
20	Description: Record a quick walkthrough and let ClipCast's AI turn it into a fully populated Jira work item in a few clicks. ClipCast automatically captures the technical details devs need (device/browser/OS, console errors, and network activity) to pinpoint the problem fast and move work forward.
21	CTA: "Learn more"
22	
23	## Feature: Screen Recorder
24	Title: The easiest screen recorder you'll ever use
25	Subtitle: Record in a few clicks. Share anywhere. Collaborate better.
26	Subsection Title: Lightning fast screen recording
27	Description: Easily record your screen and camera. Record on any device using ClipCast's Chrome extension, desktop app, or mobile app.
28	CTA: "Download now"
29	
30	## Feature: Video Editor
31	Title: So much more than a screen recorder
32	- **Edit your videos like a pro** — ClipCast's intuitive editor lets you trim, stitch clips, add eye-catching backgrounds, and even enhance your message with text, arrows, and box overlays. The result? Engaging videos you can deliver fast.
33	- **Share or embed video anywhere you work** — From Google Workspace to Slack, ClipCast videos seamlessly integrate with hundreds of tools you use every day.
34	- **Engage and connect with video** — Easily collaborate by adding emojis, comments, tasks and CTAs to your video message. Empower remote teams to communicate better across timezones using transcripts and captions in 50+ languages.
35	
36	## Feature: Security
37	Title: Keep your content safe
38	Description: Enterprise-grade security to keep your data and your customer's data private and secure. We offer SSO, SCIM as well as custom data retention policies and privacy settings.
39	CTA: "Learn more"
40	
41	## Enterprise Security
42	- GDPR, CCPA, and SOC 2 Type 2 compliant
43	- Built on the AWS-backbone with secure and reliable infrastructure
44	- Equipped with advanced admin controls to protect sensitive information internally
45	- Secured with encrypted data and industry-standard security frameworks
46	
47	## Use Cases
48	Title: Video messaging for all use cases
49	- **Sales** — Personalize your pitch with video outreach to close more deals.
50	- **Engineering** — Add visual context to your code to accelerate your sprints.
51	- **Customer support** — Troubleshoot over video to reach resolutions faster.
52	- **Design** — Share ideas and provide feedback over video to enhance designs.
53	CTA: "See all use cases"
54	
55	## Features Grid
56	Title: Powerful features for easy, custom recordings
57	- Screen and camera recording
58	- Easy sharing and embedding
59	- Trim and stitch video clips
60	- Download and upload
61	- Transcriptions and closed captions
62	- Video privacy controls
63	- Custom background
64	- Video and viewer insights
65	CTA: "See all features"
66	
67	## Enterprise Impact Stats
68	- **50%** fewer meetings across organizations
69	- **18%** increase in traffic on webpages with ClipCast videos
70	- **19%** boost in reply rates across sales outreach
71	
72	## Enterprise Async Video Benefits
73	Title: Communicate faster with async video
74	- **Save time** — Teams can communicate more efficiently without typing long emails, scheduling meetings, or trying to work across time zones.
75	- **Communicate clearly** — Async video captures context, tone, and personality in detail. Distributed teams can preserve the true meaning of their message.
76	- **Deepen culture** — Make it effortless for anyone in your organization to share ideas, introduce themselves, and build community with fellow teammates using async video.
77	
78	## Enterprise Community & Visibility
79	Title: Drive community and visibility at scale
80	- **Scale knowledge with video** — Connect pockets of institutional knowledge by making video messages searchable and discoverable.
81	- **Create a culture of sharing** — Video messaging encourages your team to share early and often so projects are visible and driven to completion quicker.
82	- **Build community at scale** — Magnify people's voices so the whole company can feel connected and heard beyond the boundaries of their team.
83	
84	## Pricing Plans
85	Title: Choose the plan that fits your needs.
86	Toggle: Monthly / Annually (SAVE UP TO 17%)
87	Slider: Team size
88	
89	| Plan | Starter | Business | Business + AI | Enterprise |
90	|------|---------|----------|---------------|------------|
91	| Price | $0 | $18/user/mo | $24/user/mo | Contact Sales |
92	| Label | — | — | MOST POPULAR | — |
93	| CTA | Sign up | Try for free | Try for free | Contact Sales |
94	
95	**Starter highlights:** 25 videos, 5 min screen recordings, unlimited meeting length, transcriptions in 50+ languages
96	**Business highlights:** Everything in Starter + unlimited videos, unlimited recording, basic waveform editing, remove branding, upload & download
97	**Business + AI highlights:** Everything in Business + auto-video enhancement, advanced editing, video-to-text automation, auto-meeting recap emails, auto-meeting notes
98	**Enterprise highlights:** Everything in Business + AI + advanced security (SSO, SCIM), Salesforce integration, 99.95% uptime SLA, admin insights

# ClipCast — One video is worth a thousand words

## Brand
ClipCast is a free screen recorder and async video messaging platform that helps teams communicate faster with AI-powered video creation, editing, and sharing. Built for professionals, remote teams, and enterprises seeking modern async communication tools.

Brand colors: #1868DB (primary blue), #FF613D (accent orange), #292A2E (dark text)

## Hero Content
Title: One video is worth a thousand words
Subtitle: Easily record and share AI-powered video messages with your teammates and customers to supercharge productivity
CTA: "Get ClipCast for free" | "Install Chrome Extension"

## Social Proof
Millions of people across 400,000 companies choose ClipCast
Trusted by: Stripe · Dropbox · HubSpot · Atlassian · Launchdarkly · Netflix

## Feature: AI Bug Reports
Label: New!
Title: Ship faster with AI bug reports
Description: Record a quick walkthrough and let ClipCast's AI turn it into a fully populated Jira work item in a few clicks. ClipCast automatically captures the technical details devs need (device/browser/OS, console errors, and network activity) to pinpoint the problem fast and move work forward.
CTA: "Learn more"

## Feature: Screen Recorder
Title: The easiest screen recorder you'll ever use
Subtitle: Record in a few clicks. Share anywhere. Collaborate better.
Subsection Title: Lightning fast screen recording
Description: Easily record your screen and camera. Record on any device using ClipCast's Chrome extension, desktop app, or mobile app.
CTA: "Download now"

## Feature: Video Editor
Title: So much more than a screen recorder
- **Edit your videos like a pro** — ClipCast's intuitive editor lets you trim, stitch clips, add eye-catching backgrounds, and even enhance your message with text, arrows, and box overlays. The result? Engaging videos you can deliver fast.
- **Share or embed video anywhere you work** — From Google Workspace to Slack, ClipCast videos seamlessly integrate with hundreds of tools you use every day.
- **Engage and connect with video** — Easily collaborate by adding emojis, comments, tasks and CTAs to your video message. Empower remote teams to communicate better across timezones using transcripts and captions in 50+ languages.

## Feature: Security
Title: Keep your content safe
Description: Enterprise-grade security to keep your data and your customer's data private and secure. We offer SSO, SCIM as well as custom data retention policies and privacy settings.
CTA: "Learn more"

## Enterprise Security
- GDPR, CCPA, and SOC 2 Type 2 compliant
- Built on the AWS-backbone with secure and reliable infrastructure
- Equipped with advanced admin controls to protect sensitive information internally
- Secured with encrypted data and industry-standard security frameworks

## Use Cases
Title: Video messaging for all use cases
- **Sales** — Personalize your pitch with video outreach to close more deals.
- **Engineering** — Add visual context to your code to accelerate your sprints.
- **Customer support** — Troubleshoot over video to reach resolutions faster.
- **Design** — Share ideas and provide feedback over video to enhance designs.
CTA: "See all use cases"

## Features Grid
Title: Powerful features for easy, custom recordings
- Screen and camera recording
- Easy sharing and embedding
- Trim and stitch video clips
- Download and upload
- Transcriptions and closed captions
- Video privacy controls
- Custom background
- Video and viewer insights
CTA: "See all features"

## Enterprise Impact Stats
- **50%** fewer meetings across organizations
- **18%** increase in traffic on webpages with ClipCast videos
- **19%** boost in reply rates across sales outreach

## Enterprise Async Video Benefits
Title: Communicate faster with async video
- **Save time** — Teams can communicate more efficiently without typing long emails, scheduling meetings, or trying to work across time zones.
- **Communicate clearly** — Async video captures context, tone, and personality in detail. Distributed teams can preserve the true meaning of their message.
- **Deepen culture** — Make it effortless for anyone in your organization to share ideas, introduce themselves, and build community with fellow teammates using async video.

## Enterprise Community & Visibility
Title: Drive community and visibility at scale
- **Scale knowledge with video** — Connect pockets of institutional knowledge by making video messages searchable and discoverable.
- **Create a culture of sharing** — Video messaging encourages your team to share early and often so projects are visible and driven to completion quicker.
- **Build community at scale** — Magnify people's voices so the whole company can feel connected and heard beyond the boundaries of their team.

## Pricing Plans
Title: Choose the plan that fits your needs.
Toggle: Monthly / Annually (SAVE UP TO 17%)
Slider: Team size

| Plan | Starter | Business | Business + AI | Enterprise |
|------|---------|----------|---------------|------------|
| Price | $0 | $18/user/mo | $24/user/mo | Contact Sales |
| Label | — | — | MOST POPULAR | — |
| CTA | Sign up | Try for free | Try for free | Contact Sales |

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>ClipCast — One video is worth a thousand words</title>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/remixicon@4.2.0/fonts/remixicon.css" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    :root {
      --blue: #1868DB;
      --orange: #FF613D;
      --dark: #292A2E;
      --gray: #6B7280;
      --light-gray: #F9FAFB;
      --border: #E5E7EB;
      --radius: 12px;
      --radius-lg: 20px;
    }
    body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--dark); background: #fff; overflow-x: hidden; }
    a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
    img { max-width: 100%; }

    /* NAV */
    nav {
      position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 0 40px; height: 64px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .nav-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; color: var(--dark); }
    .nav-logo .logo-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; background: var(--blue); border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
    .nav-logo .logo-icon i { color: #fff; font-size: 18px; }
    .nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .nav-links a { padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--gray); transition: all .2s; }
    .nav-links a:hover { background: var(--light-gray); color: var(--dark); }
    .nav-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
    .btn-ghost { padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--dark); border: 1px solid var(--border); background: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: all .2s; }
    .btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--light-gray); }
    .btn-primary { padding: 9px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; background: var(--blue); border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all .2s; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
    .btn-primary:hover { background: #1558c0; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(24,104,219,.3); }
    .btn-orange { background: var(--orange); }
    .btn-orange:hover { background: #e55530; }

    /* HERO */
    .hero {
      padding: 80px 40px 60px;
      text-align: center;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f0f5ff 0%, #fff 100%);
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute; top: -100px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 800px; height: 800px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(24,104,219,.08) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #EFF6FF; color: var(--blue); padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 50px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 24px; border: 1px solid #BFDBFE; }
    .hero h1 { font-size: clamp(40px, 6vw, 72px); font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -2px; max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto 20px; }
    .hero h1 span { color: var(--blue); }
    .hero p { font-size: 18px; color: var(--gray); max-width: 560px; margin: 0 auto 36px; line-height: 1.6; }
    .hero-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 48px; }
    .btn-lg { padding: 14px 28px; font-size: 16px; border-radius: 10px; }
    .btn-outline-lg { padding: 13px 28px; font-size: 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); background: #fff; color: var(--dark); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; transition: all .2s; }
    .btn-outline-lg:hover { border-color: var(--blue); color: var(--blue); }
    .hero-video-mockup {
      max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1868DB 0%, #7C3AED 100%);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 3px;
      box-shadow: 0 32px 80px rgba(24,104,219,.25);
    }
    .hero-video-inner {
      background: #1a1d2e; border-radius: 18px; height: 480px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-video-inner::before {
      content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' viewBox='0 0 60 60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' fill-rule='evenodd'%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='0.03'%3E%3Cpath d='M36 34v-4h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2h-4zm0-30V0h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2V6h4V4h-4zM6 34v-4H4v4H0v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2H6zM6 4V0H4v4H0v2h4v4h2V6h4V4H6z'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E");
    }
    .play-btn {
      width: 80px; height: 80px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.15);
      border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);
      cursor: pointer; transition: all .2s;
    }
    .play-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.25); transform: scale(1.05); }
    .play-btn i { font-size: 36px; color: #fff; margin-left: 4px; }

    /* LOGO BAR */
    .logo-bar { padding: 40px; text-align: center; background: #fff; }
    .logo-bar p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--gray); margin-bottom: 24px; font-weight: 500; }
    .logo-grid { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 48px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .logo-item { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #9CA3AF; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }

    /* SECTIONS */
    section { padding: 80px 40px; }
    .container { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .section-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--blue); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.5px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .section-title { font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -1px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .section-sub { font-size: 17px; color: var(--gray); line-height: 1.6; max-width: 560px; }

    /* FEATURE HIGHLIGHT */
    .feature-highlight { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e1b4b 100%); color: #fff; border-radius: 0; }
    .feature-highlight-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 60px; align-items: center; max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .feature-highlight .section-label { color: #a5b4fc; }
    .feature-highlight .section-title { color: #fff; }
    .feature-highlight .section-sub { color: #a5b4fc; max-width: 100%; }
    .new-badge { display: inline-block; background: var(--orange); color: #fff; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 50px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .feature-mockup {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.05); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); padding: 24px;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }
    .feature-mockup-content { text-align: center; }
    .feature-mockup-content i { font-size: 64px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.3); }

    /* SCREEN RECORDER */
    .screen-recorder { background: var(--light-gray); }
    .screen-recorder-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 60px; align-items: center; max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .screen-recorder-img {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1868DB, #7C3AED);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 32px;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(24,104,219,.2);
    }
    .screen-recorder-img i { font-size: 80px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.8); }

    /* VIDEO EDITOR */
    .video-editor-inner { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .video-editor-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 60px; }
    .editor-cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
    .editor-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 28px; transition: all .2s; }
    .editor-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.08); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .editor-card-icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; background: #EFF6FF; border-radius: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .editor-card-icon i { font-size: 24px; color: var(--blue); }
    .editor-card h3 { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .editor-card p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--gray); line-height: 1.6; }

    /* INTEGRATIONS */
    .integrations { background: var(--light-gray); }
    .integrations-inner { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center; }
    .integrations-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; justify-content: center; margin-top: 40px; }
    .integration-chip {
      background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 50px;
      padding: 10px 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
      font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; transition: all .2s;
    }
    .integration-chip:hover { border-color: var(--blue); color: var(--blue); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(24,104,219,.1); }
    .integration-chip i { font-size: 18px; }

    /* ENGAGEMENT */
    .engagement-inner { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .engagement-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; margin-top: 48px; }
    .engagement-card { text-align: center; padding: 32px 24px; background: var(--light-gray); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); }
    .engagement-card .stat { font-size: 48px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--blue); letter-spacing: -2px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .engagement-card p { font-size: 15px; color: var(--gray); line-height: 1.5; }

    /* SECURITY */
    .security { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e1b4b 100%); color: #fff; }
    .security-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 60px; align-items: center; max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .security .section-label { color: #a5b4fc; }
    .security .section-title { color: #fff; }
    .security .section-sub { color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); max-width: 100%; }
    .security-list { list-style: none; margin-top: 28px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
    .security-list li { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; font-size: 15px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.85); }
    .security-list li i { font-size: 20px; color: #4ADE80; margin-top: 1px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .security-badges { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
    .security-badge { background: rgba(255,255,255,.07); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
    .security-badge i { font-size: 28px; color: #a5b4fc; }
    .security-badge-text { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,.9); line-height: 1.4; }

    /* USE CASES */
    .use-cases { background: var(--light-gray); }
    .use-cases-inner { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .use-cases-header { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 48px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; }
    .use-cases-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
    .use-case-card { background: #fff; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--border); transition: all .2s; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .use-case-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.08); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .use-case-icon { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 18px; }
    .use-case-icon i { font-size: 26px; color: #fff; }
    .use-case-card h3 { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .use-case-card p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--gray); line-height: 1.6; flex: 1; }

    /* FEATURES GRID */
    .features-grid-inner { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .features-grid-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 48px; }
    .features-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 20px; }
    .feature-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; transition: all .2s; }
    .feature-item:hover { border-color: var(--blue); background: #EFF6FF; }
    .feature-item i { font-size: 20px; color: var(--blue); flex-shrink: 0; }
    .feature-item span { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; }

    /* BLOG */
    .blog { background: var(--light-gray); }
    .blog-inner { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .blog-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 48px; }
    .blog-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
    .blog-card { background: #fff; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); transition: all .2s; }
    .blog-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.08); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .blog-card-img { height: 200px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
    .blog-card-body { padding: 24px; }
    .blog-tag { display: inline-block; background: #EFF6FF; color: var(--blue); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 50px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .blog-card-body h3 { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 10px; line-height: 1.4; }
    .blog-card-body p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--gray); line-height: 1.6; }

    /* ENTERPRISE CTA */
    .enterprise-cta { background: #fff; }
    .enterprise-cta-inner { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .enterprise-cta-card { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1868DB 0%, #7C3AED 100%); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 60px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 40px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .enterprise-cta-card h2 { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 10px; letter-spacing: -0.5px; }
    .enterprise-cta-card p { font-size: 16px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.8); max-width: 480px; line-height: 1.6; }
    .btn-white { background: #fff; color: var(--blue); padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; border: none; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: all .2s; display: inline-block; }
    .btn-white:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.15); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    /* TESTIMONIALS */
    .testimonials { background: var(--light-gray); }
    .testimonials-inner { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .testimonials-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 48px; }
    .testimonials-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 20px; }
    .testimonial-card { background: #fff; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .testimonial-stars { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .testimonial-stars i { font-size: 16px; color: #FBBF24; }
    .testimonial-card p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--dark); line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 20px; font-style: italic; }
    .testimonial-author { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
    .testimonial-avatar { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .testimonial-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
    .testimonial-role { font-size: 12px; color: var(--gray); }

    /* CTA BANNER */
    .cta-banner { background: #fff; }
    .cta-banner-inner { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center; }
    .cta-banner h2 { font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px); font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -1.5px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .cta-banner p { font-size: 15px; color: var(--gray); margin-top: 16px; }
    .platform-icons { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 16px; margin-top: 8px; }
    .platform-icons span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--gray); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
    .platform-icons i { font-size: 16px; }

    /* FOOTER */
    footer { background: var(--dark); color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); padding: 60px 40px 32px; }
    .footer-inner { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .footer-top { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 200px repeat(6, 1fr); gap: 32px; margin-bottom: 48px; }
    .footer-brand h3 { color: #fff; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .footer-brand p { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; }
    .footer-col h4 { color: #fff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 16px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
    .footer-col ul { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .footer-col ul li a { font-size: 13px; transition: color .2s; }

<!DOCTYPE html>

    /* NAV */
